# ToolPixi

> ToolPixi is a free collection of online tools — image compressors, PDF tools, calculators and converters — that run 100% in your browser. Your files never leave your device: no uploads, no servers, no sign-ups.

ToolPixi at https://toolpixi.com/ offers 122 free browser-based tools across 5 categories: image compression and conversion, PDF merge/split/compress, date and age calculators, countdowns, and everyday converters. No sign-up, no upload — processing happens on your device.

## Key pages

- [ToolPixi homepage](https://toolpixi.com/): Free online tools that run in your browser — compress, convert, and calculate in seconds.
- [About ToolPixi](https://toolpixi.com/about/): What ToolPixi is, why browser-based matters for privacy, and how the tools work.
- [Privacy Policy](https://toolpixi.com/privacy/): Files are never uploaded; no accounts; no tracking cookies from ToolPixi.
- [Contact](https://toolpixi.com/contact/): Suggest a tool, report a problem, or ask a question.
- [Sitemap](https://toolpixi.com/sitemap.xml): Complete list of tool pages.

## Categories

- Image Tools: 31 tools — including Image Compressor to KB, PNG to JPG, JPG to PNG, WebP to JPG, WebP to PNG. Compress photos to an exact KB size, convert formats and fix iPhone HEIC photos.
- PDF Tools: 13 tools — including JPG to PDF, Merge PDF, Split PDF, PDF to JPG, Compress PDF. Build, merge, split and shrink PDFs — right in your browser.
- Date & Time Tools: 20 tools — including Age Calculator, Age on a Specific Date, Days Between Dates, Days Until Christmas, Christmas Countdown. Ages, countdowns and date differences, calculated instantly.
- Text & Generator Tools: 16 tools — including Word Counter, QR Code Generator, Barcode Generator, Random Number Generator, Case Converter. Word counts, QR codes, thumbnails and random numbers.
- Converters & Calculators: 42 tools — including Unit Converter, BMI Calculator, Percentage Calculator, Tip Calculator, Discount Calculator. Units, BMI, percentages and everyday money maths.

## Privacy promise

Every tool processes files locally in your web browser using open-source libraries (pdf-lib, PDF.js, heic2any). Files and typed data are never transmitted to or stored on a server. Close the tab and nothing remains.
